title: 生成 AssetLink .NET、TypeScript 与 Kotlin SDK
risks: The Windows and Ubuntu GitHub Actions matrix is defined but has not yet executed on remote runners; local evidence covers the Windows-equivalent chain and a fresh verified Gradle wrapper download.
The generator intentionally fails when the AssetLink v1 common wire-kind set changes, so future contract evolution requires an explicit generator and test update.
The dependency-minimal Kotlin sdkTest runner does not emit JUnit XML; the first Android consumer must add platform lint, instrumentation, and reporting.
Browser, Android, transport, authentication, authorization, and business-semantic behavior remain owned by future consumers rather than this wire SDK.

reused_existing_logic: M0-003 canonical AssetLink JSON schemas, evolution rules, semantic fixtures, and uint64 wire boundaries
M0-009 handoff, architecture, CI-tier, contract-sync, and V0.1 scoped-start gates
V01-001 .NET 10 solution, C# 14, locked restore, NuGet audit, license, source, and Windows/Ubuntu CI foundation
Standard System.Text.Json, Node JSON/bigint, and kotlinx.serialization JSON-tree capabilities
new_language_or_framework: Generated TypeScript 6 SDK on Node.js 24 LTS, activating the ADR-0012-approved web/extension language family
Generated Kotlin 2.3 JVM SDK on JDK 21 and Gradle 9.3.1, activating the ADR-0012-approved Android language family without Android/Compose
new_major_dependencies: TypeScript 6.0.3 as an exact development-only dependency; no TypeScript runtime dependency
Kotlin JVM Gradle plugin 2.3.20 and Gradle 9.3.1 as exact build dependencies
kotlinx-serialization-json 1.11.0 as the only new SDK runtime dependency
Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm 11.19.0, and Eclipse Temurin 21.0.12+8 as exact build/test tools
contract_changes: No public AssetLink or database contract changed; the generator only consumes the frozen canonical schemas
Internal CI-tier contract activates generated SDK drift, native build/test, dependency integrity, audit, license, size, and source-boundary gates on Windows and Ubuntu
Architecture baseline now requires target manifests, lock files, Gradle verification metadata, generator evidence, and line-ending-independent contract stamps
architecture_tests: 14 deterministic generation and fail-closed SDK policy tests
21 existing M0-003 AssetLink schema and semantic regression tests
15 MSTest cases, 5 Node test cases, and 4 Kotlin logical SDK checks
Locked dependency restore, npm audit, Gradle strict verification, license and build-size gates
Generated-source network, file-I/O, business-policy, and sensitive-log negative fixtures
git diff --check, handoff validation, v0.1-start gate, and Python cache-residue check
technical_debt: Run the new Windows and Ubuntu matrix remotely and retain its first CI evidence.
Add browser compatibility tests when the first TypeScript browser consumer activates.
Add Android lint, instrumentation, platform dependency gates, and structured test reporting when the first Android consumer activates.
Extend generator mappings deliberately when a reviewed AssetLink contract revision introduces a new common wire kind.
